entries.text: Over the next 28 days, each day we’ll either ship one thing that is a clear improvement and relevant for most codex/work users or ship a full reset. Let the improvements begin.
entries.text_zh: 在接下来的 28 天里，每天我们要么发布一项明显改进且与大多数 Codex/工作用户相关的内容，要么发布完全重置的内容。让改进开始吧。

quote.name: Tibo
quote.text:
All right, we’re locking in. Only things being worked on are simplifications, more efficiency for more usage, groundbreaking features or new models. 

Sometimes you have to invest ahead of the curve, but feedback is clear that you all want things to get simpler. On it.

entries.quote_text_zh:
好吧，我们正在锁定目标。唯一要做的就是简化、提高使用效率、突破性功能或新模型。 

有时你必须提前投资，但反馈很明显，大家都希望事情变得更简单。在它上面。

entries.text:
Day 1/

We have optimized the default speed to be ~50% faster across GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol through the subscription across all our products and partners using Sign in With ChatGPT (including OpenCode, Pi, Amp, Devin, ...).

No changes needed on your end and this should be felt within the next two hours.
entries.text_zh:
Day 1/

通过使用“使用 ChatGPT 登录”（包括 OpenCode、Pi、Amp、Devin 等）订阅我们的所有产品和合作伙伴，我们已将 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 的默认速度优化了约 50%。

您无需进行任何更改，并且应该会在接下来的两个小时内感受到这一点。

quote.name: Tibo
quote.text: Over the next 28 days, each day we’ll either ship one thing that is a clear improvement and relevant for most codex/work users or ship a full reset. Let the improvements begin.

entries.quote_text_zh: 在接下来的 28 天里，每天我们要么发布一项明显改进且与大多数 Codex/工作用户相关的内容，要么发布完全重置的内容。让改进开始吧。

entries.text:
Day 2.1/

We have made Auto-review free for all users signed in through a ChatGPT account. You can enable it in settings > permissions > auto-review. Auto-review improves upon the default sandbox setting that requires you to approve everything, which is prone to decision fatigue unless you spend a lot of time configuring specific rules.

It allows you to run long tasks while having a second agent review all actions taken by the primary agent. Its only goal is to prevent high-risk actions from being taken and to protect against unwanted actions that are not aligned with the original user intent. This  Auto-review feature is now free and does not draw usage from your plan.
entries.text_zh:
Day 2.1/

我们为所有通过 ChatGPT 帐户登录的用户免费提供自动审核。您可以在“设置”>“权限”>“自动审核”中启用它。自动审核改进了默认沙箱设置，默认沙箱设置要求您批准所有内容，这很容易导致决策疲劳，除非您花费大量时间配置特定规则。

它允许您运行长时间任务，同时让第二个代理审查主要代理采取的所有操作。其唯一目标是防止采取高风险操作，并防止与原始用户意图不一致的不需要的操作。此自动审核功能现在是免费的，不会占用您的计划的使用量。

quote.text:
Day 1/

通过使用“使用 ChatGPT 登录”（包括 OpenCode、Pi、Amp、Devin 等）订阅我们的所有产品和合作伙伴，我们已将 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 的默认速度优化了约 50%。

entries.text:
Day 2.4/

Decisions API is live. We will use this ourselves to improve the experience for everyone in many fun ways. Realtime general classifier does open some great possibilities.
entries.text_zh:
Day 2.4/

决策 API 已上线。我们将利用这一点以多种有趣的方式改善每个人的体验。实时通用分类器确实开启了一些巨大的可能性。

quote.name: OpenAI Developers
quote.text:
Let your app choose the right model, tool, or action in near real-time with Decisions API, now available to all developers in public beta.

The Decisions API makes decisions up to 10x faster than GPT-6 Luna through the Responses API.

entries.quote_text_zh:
让您的应用程序使用 Decisions API 近乎实时地选择正确的模型、工具或操作，现在所有开发人员都可以在公共测试版中使用。

Decisions API 通过 Responses API 做出决策的速度比 GPT-6 Luna 快 10 倍。

entries.text:
Day 2.3/

Never worry about remembering what you were saying with that colleague. Just talk your heart out and build up the context to load up into codex to get it all done.
entries.text_zh:
Day 2.3/

不必担心记住您与该同事所说的话。只需说出你的心声并构建上下文以加载到 Codex 中即可完成所有工作。

quote.name: ChatGPT
quote.text:
Your next meeting comes with a note-taker who can help with the follow-up.

The Meetings plugin takes notes for you and saves a personalized summary and next steps in ChatGPT Space, based on what ChatGPT knows about you and the work you’ve done together.

Keep notes private or share them with your team, then ask ChatGPT to update a project plan or draft a follow-up.

Available in beta for Pro and Business users in the ChatGPT desktop app on macOS. Enterprise is coming soon.

Download the desktop app, then search for “Meetings” in the plugin directory.
https://chatgpt.com/download/

entries.quote_text_zh:
您的下一次会议将配备一名记录员，他可以帮助您进行后续工作。

会议插件根据 ChatGPT 对您的了解以及你们一起完成的工作，为您做笔记，并在 ChatGPT Space 中保存个性化摘要和后续步骤。

将笔记保密或与您的团队共享，然后要求 ChatGPT 更新项目计划或起草后续计划。

专业版和商业版用户可以在 macOS 上的 ChatGPT 桌面应用程序中使用测试版。企业即将到来。

下载桌面应用程序，然后在插件目录中搜索“Meetings”。
https://chatgpt.com/download/

entries.text:
Day 2.2/

OK this one is smaller, but we removed some friction for when building on the API. Happy building.
entries.text_zh:
Day 2.2/

好吧，这个较小，但我们消除了在 API 上构建时的一些障碍。祝构建愉快。

quote.name: OpenAI Developers
quote.text:
We’re making it easier to qualify for higher OpenAI API rate limits.

Five paid usage tiers become three: Build, Launch, and Grow.

You can qualify for Grow, our new highest tier, with $500 in total API payments—down from $1,000 for the previous highest tier.

entries.quote_text_zh:
我们正在让您更容易获得更高 OpenAI API 速率限制的资格。

五个付费使用级别变成了三个：构建、启动和增长。

您只需支付 500 美元的 API 付款总额即可获得 Grow（我们新的最高级别）的资格，而之前最高级别的支付金额为 1,000 美元。

entries.text:
Day 3/

The big one is GPT-6 in Chat, but today is also a little celebration day with a new high of 40M active users across Codex and ChatGPT Work.

Loading a banked reset in everyone's paid accounts. See you again tomorrow!

quote.name: Tibo
quote.text:
Roundup of Day 2/

2.1/ Approve for me (auto-review) is now included and does not use usage. Can be between 2-10% of plan when used. Also better for you.
2.2/ Simplified API for builders.
2.3/ Meeting notes integrated.
2.4/ Decisions API live for builders. Will use in the app to improve the experience.

entries.text_zh:
Day 3/

最重要的是聊天中的 GPT-6，但今天也是一个小小的庆祝日，Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 的活跃用户创下了 4000 万新高。

正在把攒下的 reset 额度充进所有付费账户。明天再见！
entries.quote_text_zh:
第二天综述/

2.1/ Approve for me (Auto-review) 现在已包含并且不使用用法。使用时可以为计划的 2-10%。对你也更好。
2.2/ 为构建者简化的 API。
2.3/ 整合会议记录。
2.4/ Decisions API 为构建者而生。将在应用程序中使用以改善体验。

entries.text:
Day 4/

We have improved steering to be instant, leading to the model now reacting much faster to adjustments you make, allowing you to course-correct direction in realtime and not have the model waste effort.

Also releasing GPT-6.1 Sol ultrafast. The two work very well together.

quote.name: OpenAI Developers
quote.text:
Ultrafast is rolling out today for GPT-6.1 Sol in the API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work.

Near-Astra intelligence at up to 8x faster speeds than Sol Standard, so you can build as fast as the ideas come.

entries.text_zh:
Day 4/

我们改进了即时转向，使模型现在对您所做的调整反应更快，让您可以实时修正方向，而不会让模型浪费精力。

同时发布 GPT-6.1 Sol 超快。两者合作得很好。

resets.text: We shipped four things that were deemed good to great and some math proofs, but the vote is clear and the community demands a reset. I did calibrate it and it *seems* that the game is rigged in reset's favor, but such are the rules at the moment.  Therefore ... the reset has been processed. Enjoy!
resets.text_zh: 我们发布了四件被认为从优秀到优秀的东西以及一些数学证明，但投票结果很明确，社区要求重新设置。我确实校准了它，并且“似乎”游戏被操纵以利于重置，但这就是目前的规则。  因此...重置已处理。享受！
